name: NVIDIA L4, vLLM 0.8.5: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct FP16 long(2048/512) c=64 aggregate tok/s
unit: output tok/s AGGREGATE across 64 concurrent requests (~12.1 t/s per request)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (ree2raz/inference-bench, Modal L4 24GB, client+server collocated). Engine: vLLM v0.8.5. Model: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct FP16. Regime 'long' = 2048-in / 512-out, concurrency 64, greedy (temp=0). TTFT p50 681 ms at c=64 long. Values are medians verbatim from results/summary.csv. throughput_median is AGGREGATE output tok/s across all 64 concurrent requests; divide by 64 for the per-request rate.
notes: 2K-token prompts barely dent aggregate throughput vs the short regime (776 vs 831 t/s) — decode-bandwidth-bound, not prefill-bound. format_id=null: no fp16 record exists in data/quantization/ (FP16 is the unquantized baseline, not a format).
